name: Community signatures
description: Recurring taxon combinations found by non-negative matrix factorisation of the samples-by-taxa relative-abundance matrix. Every sample is a mixture of a few signatures, each a weighted set of taxa; the outputs give the taxa behind each signature, each sample's signature shares and the mean shares per group.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts. Group, subject and timepoint roles are carried into the per-sample table and the group figure.

n_signatures.title: Number of signatures
n_signatures.description: How many signatures to extract; reduced when the table is too small.

top_taxa.title: Taxa per signature
top_taxa.description: How many of the highest-loading taxa each signature lists.

min_prevalence_pct.title: Minimum prevalence (%)
min_prevalence_pct.description: Taxa present in fewer samples are left out of the factorisation.

transform.title: Abundance transform
transform.description: Applied to relative abundance before factorising: square root dampens dominant taxa, log more so, none keeps proportions.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Seed of the factorisation; the same seed gives the same signatures.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, use taxa of this rank only.

min_reads.title: Minimum reads per sample
min_reads.description: Samples with fewer retained reads are dropped; 0 keeps every sample.

remove_artifacts.title: Remove curated artifacts
remove_artifacts.description: Drop taxa on curation lists with the artifact role first.

outputs.name: signature_taxa
outputs.description: The highest-loading taxa of every signature with their loading, rank and curated role.

outputs.name: sample_signatures
outputs.description: One row per sample: the share of each signature, the dominant signature and its share.

outputs.name: signature_taxa_heatmap
outputs.description: Loadings of the top taxa across the signatures.

outputs.name: signatures_by_group
outputs.description: Mean signature share per group as stacked bars.

citation: Built with scikit-learn (Pedregosa et al. 2011; NMF after Lee and Seung 1999, NNDSVD initialisation after Boutsidis and Gallopoulos 2008), pandas, NumPy and Plotly. See README.md.
